chunks: Muhammad ibn Ali Majiluwayh (may God have mercy on him) narrated to us from his uncle Muhammad ibn Abi al-Qasim, from Ahmad ibn Hilal, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Abu Nasr, from Aban, from Zurara and Ismail ibn Abbad al-Qasri, from Sulayman al-Ju'fi, from Abu Abdillah al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) who said:

When the Prophet (may God's blessings be upon him and his family) was carried on the Night Journey and arrived where God, Blessed and Exalted, willed, his Lord, Mighty is His Glory, whispered to him in confidence. Then when he descended to the fourth heaven, He called out to him: 'O Muhammad!' He said: 'I am at Your service, my Lord.' He said to him: 'Who from your community have you chosen to be your vicegerent after you?' He said: 'Choose that for me, so that You may be the one who decides for me.' So He said to him: 'I have chosen for you the best of you — Ali ibn Abi Talib (peace be upon him).'

key_terms.أُسْرِيَ: The passive form of isra — the Night Journey; God 'carried' the Prophet, emphasizing divine agency
key_terms.خَلِيفَة: Vicegerent, successor, or representative; a term with deep political and theological implications in Islam
key_terms.خَيِّرَة: The chosen one, the best; used to describe Ali as God's own preferred selection
key_terms.لَبَّيْكَ: Talbiyya formula — 'at Your service/here I am'; used in hajj and as a response to divine call
key_terms.نَاجَاهُ: Private divine whispering or intimate conversation; a form of divine communication distinct from revelation (wahy)

ai.seo_question: What did God tell the Prophet about his successor during the Night Journey?
ai.summary: This hadith narrates an episode from the Prophet Muhammad's Night Journey (Isra), during which God directly asked the Prophet whom he would choose as his successor. The Prophet deferred the choice to God, who then declared Ali ibn Abi Talib as the divinely chosen successor. This account is a key Shia theological text supporting the doctrine of the divine appointment of the Imamate, as it frames Ali's succession not as a human political decision but as God's own selection.

I am at Your service/here I am
your best/the best of your kind

en.bilal-muhammad: Muhammad b. `Ali Majiluwayh (rh) narrated to us from his uncle Muhammad b. Abi’l Qasim from Ahmad b. Hilal from Ahmad b. Muhammad from Abi Nasr from Aban from Zurara and Isma`il b. `Abbad al-Qasri from Sulayman al-Ju`fi from Abi `Abdillah al-Sadiq (as).

He said: When the Prophet (s) was raised up, and he ended up where Allah willed for him, his Lord whispered to him. Then, when he descended to the fourth heaven, He called out to him: O Muhammad! He said: I am at your service, my Lord. He said to him: Who from your Nation have you chosen to be your vicegerent (khalifa) after you? He said: Choose that for me, so that You may be the decider for me. So, He said to him: I have chosen the best of you for you – `Ali b. Abi Talib (as).
